scope: Offline lesson text and bilingual exercises.

lessonsRead.observation: que comprei relative plus perfeito sequence (piscou, parou) answers the technician's causal question; cloze cues carry visible subjects a luz / o motor; DE 'den ich gestern gekauft habe' and EN 'came faulty' idiomatic; caption and visualNotes hide light/motor details.

queria saber se + present cobre matches the repaired rule tying the present to current coverage; nota fiscal complication answered by Para onde eu mando (10 words); Sie throughout, no te; recall cobre has no competing valid form.

Repaired follow-up now 12 words with A taxa / a oficina visible before entra / desconta; cloze opening 'A taxa ' matches; DE 'Fließt die Gebühr … ein, und zieht die Werkstatt …' and EN question form both natural; learner clarifies inclusion without authorising.

Você poderia mandar is a softened request; two-to-five window handled with Às duas eu trabalho, mas minha irmã pode (explicit subjects before gaps); second example imprimir uma cópia is a distinct context; DE Sie register consistent.
se … já chegou keeps perfeito, crase à oficina correct; learner only asks whether the previsão comes por escrito, never asserts earlier delivery; label duplication with L2 is licensed P5 recycling.

ajudou por um dia, mas o barulho voltou uses two perfeito events with named subjects; second example o cansaço voltou avoids speaker adjective; follow-up reports post-repair evidence (mesmo sem mangueira) before requesting avaliar de novo.

Prefiro pedir + infinitivo; recall cancelada agrees with named aula; follow-up (11 words) clarifies confirmation and start of prazo; EN repair 'When does the period start counting?' verified present; DE 'Wann beginnt die Frist zu laufen?' idiomatic.

Repaired follow-up is 12 words, Eu / A coleta visible before imprimo / pode, cloze middle string matches; morning-only limitation respected (amanhã de manhã); no lugar do contraction explained; recall fallbacks are lexical nouns with devolução uniquely fitting the wrong-item context.

chegou dez dias depois do prazo + Existe alguma…?; learner weighs the cupom with Vocês oferecem outra opção and announces no company decision; cue 'oferecer (vocês)' has visible subject; DE Ihnen/Sie consistent with formal.

Neutral register with du; assumiu o compromisso de ligar + ninguém entrou em contato; a gente + 3sg in second example; follow-up asks for chat access and protocolo without presuming an outcome; no clitic recall/speech tokens.

The flickering light precedes the stopped motor and answers how the fault developed. The backpack purchase transfers the relative clause. The German and English faulty-on-arrival phrasing is literal but gives the correct meaning.

A readable photo answers the missing receipt complication. The revised rule now limits the present to currently valid coverage, consistent with L5’s past question. The library loan is a distinct application.

The 12-word closing question confirms the fee and subsequent credit. Its finite answers entra and desconta have explicit subjects. The rule orders the written quote before authorization, and the glossary now uses the encountered autorizar.

The sister can receive the technician in the offered window. The chips bridge the sentence boundary and the replacement distractors test the requested infinitive and the afternoon timing. Printing a report transfers the request.

The promised Thursday afternoon update is translated as a delivery estimate. Asking whether the workshop gets it in writing is an acceptable practical follow-up to calling back; the learner claims no control over delivery. The wallet example transfers the past indirect question.

The repair helped for one day and the noise persists even without the hose. This answers the technician’s diagnostic distinction and motivates the reassessment. The timed study change transfers the contrast.

The learner chooses a refund over rebooking. The card and five-day limit are supplied by the school; the learner asks whether confirmation is today, which would establish a date. The updated English calls prazo a period. The bridged chunks and feminine-singular recall answer reconstruct the exact lines.

The learner will print today and asks whether collection may be tomorrow morning. This 12-word line respects the offered morning window and leaves scheduling to the shop. Imprimo and pode have visible subjects. The tea-for-coffee transfer and the return vocabulary are aligned.

The store offers its coupon and the learner asks what else it can offer. The ten-day delay and distinct late-application example support the time expression. The revised build bridge preserves both sentences.

A neighbour working for the provider advises following up by chat. The learner asks for access and the case number, not a decision. Neutral du and the community-garden transfer fit. All ten trophies, caption openings, word limits, build/cloze/recall reconstructions and nonfinal chip endings were checked on the signed bytes.

findings.issue: The timing question is understandable in context. 'When does the period start counting?' and the vocabulary gloss 'money refund' are literal.
findings.recommendation: Optional polishing at the next translation pass: 'When do the five days start?' and 'refund'.

findings.issue: The canonical answer is listed first in the source. It remains the only word for returning the incorrect lamp, and source position does not create a second valid answer.
findings.recommendation: Optional native-review note: vary the source option order if desired.

lessonsRead.observation: The fan stops on its first night. Flickering before the motor stops supplies the requested sequence. Defeito is in the first learner turn and the backpack-on-the-train example transfers que comprei to a different scene. The singular fan licenses veio.

The technician needs proof of purchase and volunteers that a legible photo works. The learner has a photo and asks where to send it. The library loan is an independent setting for queria saber se. Cobre has one subject-compatible answer.

The cyclist asks for a written estimate before giving permission. The course-enrolment example reuses the timing frame. The mechanic's fee and credit need to be distinguished in the final question. One blank violates the explicit regular future-subjunctive restriction.

The provider proposes a window and the learner nominates someone available at home. A printed report is a different real use of the request frame. The conjugation questions are fair, but a cake and sleeping give away both build decoys.

The supplier plans to update the ETA on Thursday afternoon, and the learner does not promise delivery. The lost-wallet example transfers the indirect question. Follow-up language should ask for the estimate itself; both base locales currently use weather-like wording.

Replacing the filter helped for one day. Hearing the motor with the hose detached answers the diagnostic choice, then the learner requests another assessment. The study/exams model transfers the temporary improvement and setback. No authority is claimed.

The school offers rebooking, the learner prefers a refund, and the office explains the card and five-business-day period. The final question asks again when the already-explained clock starts. Preferring written correspondence is a different use of prefiro.

The wrong delivery is a lamp rather than a mirror. The café order transfers the substitution pattern. The shop authorizes morning collection from reception but has not confirmed tomorrow. The speaker currently schedules the carrier unilaterally.

The shop offers a one-month coupon for the ten-day delivery delay. The learner gives a reason and asks about alternatives, leaving authority with the store. Late application submission genuinely transfers the time expression. Chegou has one compatible subject.

The neighbour's dual role explains colloquial você/German du and her knowledge of the provider. She proposes the chat after the missed callback. The learner asks where to find the case number. The community-garden commitment transfers the pattern to another scene.

findings.issue: Came faulty and kam mit einem Defekt are calques in the principal model.
findings.recommendation: Use e.g. 'The fan I bought yesterday was faulty: it stopped working on the very first night' and 'Der Ventilator, den ich gestern gekauft habe, war schon beim Kauf defekt: Schon in der ersten Nacht fiel er aus.' Carry these idioms through related learner-facing glosses.

findings.issue: The general statement that the verb after se stays in the present conflicts with the same pack's perfectly legitimate indirect past question in L5.
findings.recommendation: Say the subordinate verb here is present because the customer asks what the warranty currently covers. It agrees with a garantia.

findings.issue: Aprovar is a regular future subjunctive, which the official spec explicitly says never to blank. The exchange also obscures whether the evaluation fee appears as a separate line or is credited against the repair. The DE and EN rules reverse the sequence: the infinitive names the later authorization, while the main clause gives the earlier request.
findings.recommendation: Use a clear follow-up with two independent visible-subject finite forms, e.g. 'A taxa aparece separada no orçamento ou já faz parte do total?' (a taxa for both). Translate a credit as 'wird auf die Reparaturkosten angerechnet' / 'counts toward the repair cost'. Rewrite the rule so asking for the quote comes before authorizing.

findings.issue: Four nonfinal build chips end a full sentence: L4 toda tarde., L7 da aula cancelada., L8 no lugar do espelho., L9 dez dias depois do prazo. These do not meet the archive chunk boundary.
findings.recommendation: Preserve each full utterance; move the boundary inside the next chip, with informative combined DE/EN glosses. For L4, e.g., A internet / ainda cai / toda tarde. Você poderia / mandar um técnico aqui? Verify 4–7 chips and exact reconstruction for all four.

findings.issue: Cake/sleep in the internet-service scene, senha for the washing-machine part, the delayed bus at the language school, and soup for the parcel contents can be discarded from topic alone.
findings.recommendation: Use comparable, scene-specific contrasts that contradict the established facts, or one believable conjugation/agreement error. E.g. for L4 test singular internet and an intentionally mismatched finite verb after poderia. Avoid equally viable repair requests or alternate pickups.

findings.issue: The planned task is to request an ETA. The learner asks whether the workshop receives the estimate in writing, which never requests it. 'Forecast' and 'Prognose' are out of place for a delivery update.
findings.recommendation: Ask for the date after the supplier's update, e.g. 'Então eu ligo depois do almoço. A oficina pode confirmar a previsão?' Use Liefertermin / voraussichtlicher Liefertermin and estimated delivery date throughout. Keep both new form subjects visible.

findings.issue: The clerk just said the period starts at confirmation, so asking 'Quando o prazo começa a contar?' repeats a settled fact. 'When does the deadline start counting?' and 'money refund' are unidiomatic.
findings.recommendation: Ask a new question about the confirmation, e.g. 'Eu recebo essa confirmação hoje ou a escola avisa por e-mail?' or two linked questions about timing and receipt. Use 'refund' / 'getting your money back' and 'five-business-day period' where relevant.

findings.issue: A coleta é só de manhã specifies time of day and the clerk allows reception pickup. Neither turn books tomorrow. The learner states the carrier and reception will meet tomorrow.
findings.recommendation: Request the day while accepting the offered handoff, e.g. 'Então eu deixo a caixa na portaria. A coleta pode ser amanhã?' Update the two localized lines and cloze for deixo (eu), pode (a coleta).

findings.issue: Eu compro aqui raramente puts raramente in a marked position in a plain explanation.
findings.recommendation: Use 'Eu raramente compro aqui.' Keep the explicit subject before the blank.
